mode: built-in image_gen with user-authorized local compositing and solid background normalization

prompt_specification.base: Refine the supplied single character portrait into consistent crisp fantasy anime cel shading and clean linework. Preserve identity, face, expression, pose, costume and crop. Exactly one character. Flat blue #17468C background, no scenery or gradient.
prompt_specification.1: Based on frame 0, slightly open the visible mouth wider, respecting the actual mouth location and anatomy, including beasts and dragons. Preserve everything else.
prompt_specification.2: Based on frame 0, close the visible mouth naturally. Preserve everything else.
prompt_specification.3: Based on frame 0, fully close the eyes; for mechanical portraits turn off the eye lights. Preserve everything else.

postprocessing: Composite only approved mouth or eye regions onto frame 0. Hidden mouths retain frame 0 for frames 1 and 2. Hidden eyes retain frame 0 for frame 3. Background RGB(23,70,140).
exception_731: Image generation blocked twice. Composited existing generated unlit sensor glass from character 740 into the two eye sensor regions.
